changes: Roll motors and propellers
5 in propellers in 137 mm ducts, 44 mm forward of the spar
the pair makes 1,646 g instead of 816 g, which is what brings the hardest-working fan under 60%
Lift-fan motor
2807 size, about 1,500 KV
the fan is torque-limited at 35 A, so a lower KV gives 1,344 g instead of 1,206 g
Landing gear
three retractable legs in place of two tall skids
nothing in the airflow; 36 g of servos is the price
Wiring
25 separate runs in two belly raceways, a connector at each end
honest mass is 132 g, not the 45 g the first draft assumed
Speed controllers
three of the four beside the battery, under the hatch
shorter motor runs and a balance point the battery can still trim
Tailplane
1.5x area
trim at 18 m/s took 19.5 of the 25 degrees available, leaving nothing for manoeuvre
Tubes
8 x 1 mm carbon in place of 8 mm aluminium
24 g, and stiffer
Battery
4-cell 2,700 mAh
2,200 mAh met every target but hover time; 3,300 mAh is too heavy for the fan margin
